slides.sub: Qatari Diar updates on Huzoom Lusail and The Seef, via The Peninsula

captions.linkedin:
More than 800 villas are already under construction at Huzoom Lusail.

According to The Peninsula (24 November), Qatari Diar shared updates on two Lusail communities during a media tour:
• Huzoom Lusail: over 800 villas being built by private owners and developers, on a master plan of 2,883 villa plots
• The Seef: more than 150 of its 578 residences now occupied

Why it matters for agencies:
Every villa finished and every unit occupied is a future resale, rental or tenant search. Lusail is turning from a launch story into a lived-in neighbourhood, and the enquiries brokers get will change with it.

What to do now:
• Know the area in detail: plot sizes, payment plans, what's finished and what's next
• Keep every Lusail listing accurate on each portal you use
• Reply to Lusail enquiries fast, while buyers are still comparing
• Track which lead sources bring Lusail buyers and tenants

(Keeping listings and leads in one place is what we built OneLinker CRM for.)
